title: Freesolo: Full-Stack Platform for Post-Training
excerpt: Freesolo builds tools for autonomous, efficient, and inexpensive training of small models.
content_html:
Not every AI interaction is best served by a frontier model. For a long tail of tasks, the intelligence exists, but serving it at acceptable latency and cost doesn’t. Engineers have to choose between model size and quality: as models got smaller, performance dropped off. Post-training closes that gap, but the current standard isn’t enough. Iterative post-training by using agent loops is what gets small models over the line, and today the activation energy to train is far too high. Freesolo builds tools for autonomous, efficient, and inexpensive training of small models.
